What's more, it is astonishing to witness Bajaj Allianz's blatant disregard for customer concerns. This disregard is especially shocking when it comes to refunding premiums that were erroneously collected.

Even their so-called customer care, which should serve as a channel for resolution, has proven to be equally negligent. I followed their provided escalation details, yet my refund remains elusive. To add insult to injury, it appears they have conveniently closed the case without resolution.

I can only imagine how many other innocent customers have fallen victim to their unprofessionalism and lack of accountability, forfeiting their hard-earned money for non-existent policies.

Planning a once-in-a-lifetime trek to Everest Base Camp? 🏔️ Make sure your journey is not just memorable, but also safe with the right Travel Insurance cover.

At Merit Insurance IMF & Wealth Pvt. Ltd., we specialize in providing comprehensive Travel Insurance solutions for adventure seekers heading to high-altitude destinations like Everest Base Camp. Trekking in such extreme conditions comes with risks like altitude sickness, medical emergencies, trip interruptions, and unexpected evacuations. That’s why having the right protection is absolutely essential.

We offer Travel Insurance plans with coverage up to $500,000, ensuring you are financially protected against major uncertainties. Our policies include coverage for emergency hospitalization, evacuation (including helicopter rescue where applicable), trip cancellations, baggage loss, and more.

We partner with trusted and reputed insurance companies like Tata AIG, Care Insurance, and other leading insurers to bring you reliable and comprehensive plans tailored to your travel needs. Whether you're a solo traveler, part of a trekking group, or an adventure enthusiast ticking off your bucket list, we ensure you travel with confidence and peace of mind.

Don’t let uncertainties hold you back from your dream adventure. Secure your Everest Base Camp journey with the right insurance coverage.
